# CeremonyVerse

> CeremonyVerse is a U.S.-based Gujarati and Hindu destination-wedding planning service for families throughout the United States and Canada, focused on weddings in Mexico, Jamaica, and Punta Cana. Optional India wedding-outfit sourcing is available as a separate paid service or as part of an approved planning scope.

## Founder

CeremonyVerse is founded and led by Bhamini (publicly known as Mini), the named family-facing destination-wedding concierge, based in Newtown Township, Pennsylvania, USA. Mini is the named planning contact for family approvals, guest information, decision records, and optional India sourcing coordination.

## Primary Service

CeremonyVerse helps Gujarati and Hindu families organize multi-day destination weddings through one documented family-facing process. Current destination positioning is Mexico, Jamaica, and Punta Cana. Planning can include resort and proposal comparison, event schedules, cultural requirements, guest information, room-block decision support, family approvals, local-team coordination, wedding-week execution, and closeout as defined in a private written proposal.

## Free Consultation and Paid Next Steps

The first 30-minute consultation is free. No payment or contract is required for that introductory call. After the consultation, CeremonyVerse may recommend a separate paid scope.

The Destination Wedding Feasibility & Action Plan is $300. It is a standalone written planning service. When an eligible CeremonyVerse destination-planning contract is signed within the stated 30-day credit window after delivery, the $300 is credited toward the CeremonyVerse planning service fee under the published terms.

Published destination-planning starting fees are:

- Event Coordination & Management: starting at $4,000 USD
- Partial Planning & Coordination: starting at $5,500 USD
- Full Planning & Design: starting at $8,000 USD

Wedding-specific proposals may change with dates, destination, event count, guest count, staffing, travel, lodging, site visits, complexity, and requested additions. Resort, room, venue, vendor, production, travel-provider, tax, permit, insurance, and other third-party costs are separate unless expressly included in the signed proposal.

## Optional India Wedding-Outfit Sourcing

CeremonyVerse offers remote India shopping support for families in the United States and Canada. The service focuses on wedding wardrobes and approved related accessories—not a currently promoted ceremonial-item sourcing program.

Possible in-scope work includes:

- Bridal lehengas and sarees
- Groom sherwanis and bandhgalas
- Bridesmaid, groomsmen, parent, sibling, and family outfits
- Coordinated color and style records
- Measurements and written approvals
- Eligible live video or current-media review
- Order follow-up and available pre-shipping review
- Shipping-document and tracking coordination

Published sourcing service fees are:

- Guided Sourcing: $799 USD
- Full Bridal Concierge: $2,499 USD

Products, tailoring, carrier charges, insurance, customs duties, taxes, brokerage, and local alterations are separate unless a signed agreement expressly includes them.

- [India Wedding Shopping](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/buy-indian-wedding-outfits-from-india/)
- [Bridal Lehenga Sourcing](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/services/bridal-lehengas/)
- [Groom Sherwani Sourcing](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/buy-sherwani-from-india-usa/)
- [Bridesmaid and Family Outfits](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/bridesmaid-and-family-outfits-from-india/)
- [Shipping and Customs Calculator](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/planning-tools/shipping-customs/)

## Service Area and Responsibilities

CeremonyVerse serves families virtually throughout the United States and Canada. Current destination-planning positioning is Mexico, Jamaica, and Punta Cana. Availability and the selected destination execution team are confirmed for each wedding in writing.

CeremonyVerse does not independently sell rooms, flights, airport transfers, or travel insurance. Resorts and appropriately qualified travel, transfer, venue, and vendor providers issue and control their own contracts, bookings, payments, availability, and service terms.

The private CeremonyVerse proposal identifies:

- Included planning or sourcing work
- Exclusions
- CeremonyVerse fees
- Known outside costs
- Payment milestones
- Approval responsibilities
- Change and cancellation rules
- The responsible provider for each outside service

## Trust and Experience

CeremonyVerse was shaped by firsthand family-side involvement in multi-day Indian destination weddings in Mexico. Those family weddings are disclosed as family experience, not represented as ordinary paid CeremonyVerse client projects or testimonials.

CeremonyVerse does not claim guaranteed savings, perfect fit, identical handmade results, resort availability, customs timing, or third-party performance. Current written terms from the responsible provider control those outside services.
